## Feature and parity

- Feature:
- Platform step: Mac implementation / Windows implementation
- Matching implementation status: complete / pending on the other computer
- Matching behavior contract (same user action, labels/options, and privacy):
- Any known platform gap:

## Checks

- [ ] macOS CI job passes
- [ ] Windows CI job passes
- [ ] Native Mac smoke check completed (or marked unverified with reason)
- [ ] Native Windows smoke check completed (or marked unverified with reason)
- [ ] Marked pending if the matching platform step has not merged yet
- [ ] README/plugin instructions and privacy note updated when needed
- [ ] Release claims match behavior verified on both platforms (only check on the parity-completing PR)
